requirement:
Create a small Node.js (CommonJS) module tested with Jest. Put the implementation in `src/roman.js` and your own tests in `tests/roman.test.js`; include a package.json whose only devDependency is "jest": "29.7.0". No other dependencies.

SPEC: Export `romanToInt(text)` converting a valid roman numeral (I V X L C D M, subtractive pairs IV IX XL XC CD CM) to a number. Empty input or unknown characters throw an Error.
